purpose: Validate the forward-only P5C semantic postcondition normalization fix after s06 proved that the real semantic click delivered successfully and the AppKit radio became checked/selected in Computer Control's normalized description while Computer Use still rejected the raw snapshot because it recognized only [selected] and not role-qualified [checked].
requiredClaims: Computer Use semantic interpretation normalizes [checked] as selected only for semantically selectable radio/radio-button/checkbox roles; [focused] alone remains insufficient and [checked] on a normal button remains insufficient.
The fix is interpretation-only in Computer Use; Computer Control delivery mechanics and product SHA remain unchanged.
The semantic branch uses the same isolated test-owned AppKit Provider and radio target physically diagnosed in s06.
OPEN attempts the existing semantic operation before any visual perception.

A real semantic click on RUMIAI SEMANTIC 731 produces independent post-action accessibility evidence sufficient for semantic OPEN success without invoking P5A, the visual provider or the visual post-action observer.
The visual target RUMIAI CLICK 517 remains absent from the semantic fixture accessibility representation and therefore produces structured NO_SEMANTIC_TARGET.
Only that P5B-eligible structured semantic observability gap reaches the explicit P5C visual fallback handoff.
The visual branch reuses the already physically validated P4/P5A visual-only fixture and local macOS Vision helper only as an injected PoC provider; P5D provider selection is not introduced.
A real Computer Control click may prove CLICK_POSTED delivery but delivery alone is never task success.
Visual OPEN succeeds only after a fresh independent post-action visual observation satisfies the exact RUMIAI DONE 864 postcondition and returns VERIFIED_SUCCESS.
Planner output remains semantic and contains no provider, visual target query, postcondition or screen coordinates.
Screenshot bytes, OCR payload text and action coordinates remain ephemeral and are not persisted in session evidence.
Computer Use and Computer Control working trees remain clean after the session.
nonClaims: P5C does not wire provider selection or visual fallback configuration into the normal agent loop; that remains P5E after P5D.
P5C does not define concrete perception-provider discovery or selection; that remains P5D.
The AppKit radio fixture is test infrastructure only and creates no product dependency or application-specific behavior.
P5C does not treat focus alone as semantic success and does not reinterpret arbitrary checked markers as success for non-selectable roles.
P5C does not make semantic action-delivery failure or semantic postcondition-verification failure visually eligible.
P5C does not claim general OCR accuracy, fuzzy matching, VLM/object/icon targeting or arbitrary coordinate planning.
The P1-P4 physical sessions and P5A/P5B evidence remain immutable and are not rerun or rewritten.

P5C s06 evidence commit 9b695a32383ae22b70dd1498d823ebb27ae0080b remains immutable: the radio fixture still returned OPEN verification failed; follow-up diagnostic e5abb9c051af5dc7e621a8162859361de5465090 proved after-marker-focused=true, after-marker-selected=false, after-marker-checked=false in the diagnostic's exact-line filter, while Computer Control describe independently reported after-described-selected=true and after-described-checked=true, establishing a semantic representation mismatch rather than a delivery failure.

evidencePolicy.onFailure: Preserve s07 unchanged, diagnose the exact remaining failure, fix forward, and create s08 only if required.
